note: Baseline recorded from the Day 1 evidenced run against Inji Verify 0.18.2. Only module 01 has been executed; the remaining 11 modules of the plan are absent deliberately rather than guessed, and the gate treats an absent module as SKIP with a warning. Add each one as it is run, with its own evidence path. Every entry must carry a reason and evidence: an expected failure without a documented reason is a silenced test.

oid4vp-1final-verifier-happy-flow.reason: F-03 - Inji Verify 0.18.2 sends presentation_definition (Presentation Exchange) rather than dcql_query, so the module terminates at ExtractDCQLQueryFromAuthorizationRequest. Structural gap, not a regression.

inji-certify._comment: Not yet exercised. Certify's issuer plan has 61 modules and its docker-compose-injistack needs a PKCS12 keystore, a public DID endpoint, an external authorisation server and partner API keys. See Q7.
